human_tolerance.notes: Judgement: a marsh breeder that is not described as using gardens or towns in the sources checked; wetland loss is the main pressure.

phases.name: breeding
phases.note: Authored window: nesting in marsh vegetation over ground or water (Wikipedia). No open-licence source with exact US breeding dates was verified; boundaries are authored and vary with latitude.

phases.name: absent
phases.note: Authored. Wikipedia says the species is probably all migratory, mainly to the southeastern United States, with small numbers resident at the southern edge of the breeding range. A US-wide fraction cannot represent the separate northern and southern winter distributions.

vocalizations.description: Monotone trill, slower than a chipping sparrow's, with a repertoire of several trills per male (Wikipedia). Timing across the year is not verified.
Loud chip, the common call note (Wikipedia). Its alarm function is assumed from the call's role in the shared program and is not separately verified.

range.note: Wikipedia: breeds across the northern United States and boreal Canada; winter in the southeastern United States. Country codes derived from that description; not a range map.

traits.limb_count.note: Bipedal passerine; the schema's limb-count convention is 2 for birds.

traits.locomotion_modes.note: Judgement. Wikipedia says it forages on the ground near water's edge and in marsh vegetation but does not name a gait; Hop is the gait of the shared passerine program. Walk was not verified and is not listed.

traits.flight.note: Powered flight is inferred from the passerine body plan; Wikipedia does not describe flight mechanics.

traits.nest_type.note: Wikipedia: a bulky nest attached to marsh vegetation, often just above the ground or surface of the water, with leaves or grass arching over. Mapped to the closest schema value Cup; Ground would misstate the placement.

traits.perching.note: Judgement: sings from perches in marsh vegetation; Wikipedia gives no perching behaviour.

traits.size_class.note: From mass_kg by the validator's size-class bounds.

traits.mass_kg.note: EltonTraits BodyMass-Value 16.1 g (source Dunning08, SpecLevel 1). Scholer row 311 mass column also 16.1 g.

traits.length_m.note: Midpoint of Wikipedia length 12-15 cm (4.7-5.9 in).

traits.wingspan_m.note: Midpoint of Wikipedia wingspan 18-19 cm (7.1-7.5 in).

traits.lifespan_y.note: Derived, not measured. Inputs: adult apparent annual survival s = 0.431 (Scholer row 311, SE 0.036, mark-recapture, attributed to Desante et al. 2015). Assumptions: constant survival, first-year survival equal to adult survival, no emigration. Expected years lived from birth = 1/(1 - s) = 1.76. Limits: first-year survival is normally lower than adult survival, so this is probably an upper bound for a typical from-hatching lifespan; the Scholer survival value is apparent survival and is not corrected for emigration, which biases it the other way. No juvenile survival was found.

traits.diet.note: EltonTraits Diet-Inv 40, Diet-Fruit 30, Diet-Seed 30; all other EltonTraits diet columns 0 (annual figure, no seasonal split). Wikipedia: arthropods in the breeding season, mainly fruit and seeds in winter.

traits.social.note: Judgement: pairs in the breeding season. No open-licence source checked gives the social structure.

traits.activity_pattern.note: EltonTraits Nocturnal = 0. Diurnal is the assumed activity pattern; no source gives its pattern directly.

traits.defense.note: Judgement: flies to cover when disturbed, as the shared passerine program assumes.

traits.wariness.note: Judgement (0.35). No open-licence source checked states wariness.

habitat.use.note: EltonTraits ForStrat-ground 100 is a foraging stratum, not a habitat-use share; it is entered as ground 1.0.

habitat.shelter_tag.note: The schema has no marsh-vegetation tag. shrub_thicket is the closest available cover for dense marsh vegetation; limitation.

habitat.resources.note: Food and nesting resources follow the Wikipedia habitat and diet text. Months for invertebrates (Apr-Aug) and seeds and fruit (Sep-Mar) are authored, and the phase boundaries are not sourced.

habitat.human_tolerance.note: Judgement: no open-licence source checked describes garden or urban use.

seasonal.note: PartialMigration and winter_fraction 0.1 are authored from Wikipedia (probably all migratory; small resident numbers at the southern edge) and the Scholer row's migrant class. Phase dates are authored and not verified for US latitudes.

vocalizations.note: Song and chip descriptions from Wikipedia. Season and time windows are authored; the alarm function is assumed.

behavior.note: Authored choice of the shared bt-perching-songbird-v1 program. Ground foraging and marsh nesting from Wikipedia. Its hard-coded April and May nest months are inherited: with nest_m1 6 and nest_m2 7 the enabled set is {4,5,6,7}, which matches the authored April-July breeding window (Apr-May are not contradicted by the sources). Its single food_tag cannot switch food by season. Hop feeding gait is judgement. No gait or nest-timing source was verified.

look.note: Authored visual model. Colours follow Wikipedia's description (rusty wings and upperparts, grey breast, grey face with a dark eye line) and are not a colour measurement.
